title: Module Summary: CSS Layout and Visual Systems

concepts.name: CSS selector
concepts.description: A pattern that identifies which elements a CSS rule applies to.

concepts.name: Cascade
concepts.description: The CSS system that determines which style rules win when multiple rules apply.

concepts.name: Specificity
concepts.description: The ranking system CSS uses to decide which selector is more targeted when rules conflict.

concepts.name: Inheritance
concepts.description: The way some CSS property values pass from parent elements to child elements.

concepts.name: Class selector
concepts.description: A CSS selector that targets elements with a specific class attribute.

concepts.name: ID selector
concepts.description: A CSS selector that targets the element with a specific id attribute.

concepts.name: Content box
concepts.description: The innermost area of an element box where content is displayed.

concepts.name: Padding
concepts.description: Space between an element’s content and its border.

concepts.name: Border
concepts.description: The line or edge surrounding an element’s padding and content.

concepts.name: Margin
concepts.description: Space outside an element’s border separating it from neighboring elements.

concepts.name: box-sizing
concepts.description: A CSS property controlling whether width and height include content only or also padding and border.

concepts.name: Spacing scale
concepts.description: A consistent set of spacing values used to create rhythm and alignment in a design.

concepts.name: Flex container
concepts.description: An element whose children are laid out using the flexbox layout model.

concepts.name: Flex item
concepts.description: A direct child of a flex container participating in flex layout.

concepts.name: Main axis
concepts.description: The primary direction in which flex items are laid out.

concepts.name: Cross axis
concepts.description: The axis perpendicular to the flexbox main axis.

concepts.name: justify-content
concepts.description: A flexbox property that aligns items along the main axis.

concepts.name: align-items
concepts.description: A flexbox property that aligns items along the cross axis.

concepts.name: Grid container
concepts.description: An element whose children are laid out using CSS Grid.

concepts.name: Grid track
concepts.description: A row or column in a CSS Grid layout.

concepts.name: Grid area
concepts.description: A rectangular region of grid cells used to place content.

concepts.name: Media query
concepts.description: A CSS rule that applies styles only when conditions such as viewport width are met.

concepts.name: Responsive layout
concepts.description: A layout that adapts to different screen sizes, devices, and content conditions.

concepts.name: Breakpoint
concepts.description: A defined condition where layout or styling changes for different viewport sizes.
